_meta.description: Page size and margin presets for Indian legal documents. Conveniences only - verify your court's current requirements.

high_court_standard.label: High Court Standard (Legal)
high_court_standard.note: Traditional legal-size (8.5 x 14 in) layout carried over from AB Layout 3.x. Many courts now require A4.

high_court_new.label: High Court New* (A4)
high_court_new.note: A4 with 2.54 cm (1 inch) margins on all sides.

sc_a4_2020.label: Supreme Court A4 (Circular 2020)
sc_a4_2020.note: Supreme Court of India circular F.No.01/Judl./2020 dated 05.03.2020: A4, margins 4 cm left and right, 2 cm top and bottom. Verify current requirements.

notary_affidavit.label: Notary / Affidavit
notary_affidavit.note: Letter size; leaves 16.5 cm at the top of page 1 for the stamp-paper heading. Needs a section break after page 1.
